probe: tests/abi/Teardown.fs image probes ("image with ...", cycle before disposal none / single / 20 ms)
cause: ImageLoader keeps the image (and so the document) while its load or error event is pending and releases it from a zero-delay timer (m_derefElementTimer); the error/load event sender is also a zero-delay timer. A fixed 20 ms post-destroy cycle can end before both fire.
fix: imageProbe: after rv_host_destroy, cycle the run loop until the watched image reads -1 (10 s hang guard); the after-cycle read is the settled state.
